fields.statement: Change set 'check without what-if rebuilds': all three leaves are built. The read-entries-parallel verifier fails that leaf only on the 5 s check target (check-time-target). At e4d148ed5, rhiza check in ~/code/rhiza took 11.67 s wall at load ~3 (16.25 s user + 4.14 s sys, which is ≥5.1 s even on 4 perfect cores). The builder measured 7.3–9.5 s at load ~2, down from 20.6 s at base. The decode it parallelised was only ~1.3 s of CPU. The rest is WhatIfFrom (~19%), checker.model/inFlightLinks and render, all outside this leaf. Everything else (tests, -race, same output order, no dependency) passes. check-time-target says the leaf fails and the gap is raised, not the target loosened. How should it be settled?
